items.title: Alan Broadbent interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 26, 2023
items.q: So the Japanese Benny Goodman band was here performing

ctx.x: I see. I think I read something in this Woody Herman book that you actually fell into a hole in Japan on some Woody Herman concert?

Yeah, yeah, yeah. That was a real thing. Well that’s another story. No there was this gentlemen’s club that we played somewhere in Tokyo, I don’t know, but it had movable stages, like this you know. So the Japanese Benny Goodman band was here performing and we were under here waiting. Then we came up, like this, and we played our set. And anyway that’s how I grabbed myself instead of falling into all the chains and gears below. So anyway. Long story short.

Okay. I want to ask you to get sort of specific about one of your works, “Developing Story” which you were kind enough to send a link to. And I tried to do a little music analyzation at the end of the first movement because it’s really gorgeous and — near the end there’s a pause. It sounds like the piece is over. And there’s a few seconds of silence and then you come back in. So before I describe then you come back in, do you recall writing that and scoring it and so forth and you got to that place and you…
